findings.summary: SONAME / VERSION not set on the library — versioned SO symlinks will be absent at runtime
findings.evidence: cmake side: set_target_properties(${OpenBLAS_LIBS} PROPERTIES VERSION 0.3 SOVERSION 0) at lines 353–356, guarded only by NOT FIXED_LIBNAME (which is OFF in the conversion). Bazel side: the openblas_static cc_library and the alias :openblas carry no soname or version attributes; Bazel cc_library has no first-class VERSION/SOVERSION knob, so the intent requires explicit linkopts or a genrule wrapping objcopy — neither is present.

findings.summary: Library binary not in any pkg_files install rule — install(TARGETS …) has no Bazel equivalent
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 529–543 install the openblas_static / openblas_shared library archive and SO to CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR via install(TARGETS … EXPORT OpenBLASTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION … LIBRARY DESTINATION …). Bazel side: exactly one pkg_files rule exists (install_files__include_openblas) and it covers only six LAPACKE headers; there is no pkg_files for the compiled libopenblas.a artifact.

findings.summary: Entire test suite absent — utest, test (Fortran BLAS), ctest (CBLAS), cpp_thread_test, and lapack-netlib/TESTING executables never authored
findings.evidence: cmake side: enable_testing() at line 307, then add_subdirectory(utest) for C unit tests, add_subdirectory(test) for Fortran sblat*/dblat*/cblat*/zblat* level-1/2/3 tests, add_subdirectory(lapack-netlib/TESTING) for LAPACK eigensolver/linear-system test suite, add_subdirectory(ctest) for CBLAS tests, add_subdirectory(cpp_thread_test) for parallel DGEMM/DGEMV thread-safety tests. Bazel side: zero cc_test or sh_test targets in any BUILD.bazel file across the converted workspace; BUILD_TESTING is baked OFF but no Bazel test targets exist even as stubs.

findings.summary: cblas.h is used raw instead of the generated version — the unconditional 'common' → 'openblas_config' substitution is skipped
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 579–597 unconditionally replace '#include "common"' with '#include "openblas_config"' in cblas.h (and apply SYMBOLPREFIX/SYMBOLSUFFIX mangling), then write the result and install it. Bazel side: root_headers lists the unmodified source cblas.h; install_files__include_openblas does not include cblas.h at all. The generated cblas.h is never produced.

findings.summary: f77blas.h not generated — the Fortran-interface header combining openblas_config.h and common_interface.h is never produced or installed
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 566–576 (guarded by NOT NOFORTRAN) generate f77blas.h by concatenating an include guard, '#include "openblas_config.h"', and the full text of common_interface.h, then install to CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR. Bazel side: no write_file or genrule produces f77blas.h; the file is absent from install_files__include_openblas.

findings.summary: openblas_config.h not generated — the public configuration header consumers #include is never produced or installed
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 552–564 generate openblas_config.h by reading config.h, prefixing every macro with OPENBLAS_, appending OPENBLAS_VERSION and openblas_config_template.h contents, then installing to CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR. Bazel side: gen_config_h (write_file) produces config.h only; no rule transforms it into openblas_config.h, and install_files__include_openblas does not list openblas_config.h.

findings.summary: CMake package-config files incomplete — OpenBLASConfig.cmake and OpenBLASConfigVersion.cmake never generated; OpenBLASTargets.cmake generated but not installed via pkg_files
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 622–637 use configure_package_config_file(cmake/OpenBLASConfig.cmake.in → OpenBLASConfig.cmake), write_basic_package_version_file(→ OpenBLASConfigVersion.cmake), and install(EXPORT … DESTINATION lib/cmake/OpenBLAS). Bazel side: gen_lib_cmake_OpenBLAS_OpenBLASTargets_cmake produces OpenBLASTargets.cmake only; no write_file generates OpenBLASConfig.cmake or OpenBLASConfigVersion.cmake; no pkg_files installs any of the three files.

findings.summary: pkg-config file generated but never installed — gen_openblas_pc produces openblas.pc with hardcoded paths and no pkg_files rule ships it to lib/pkgconfig/
findings.evidence: cmake side: line 618 configure_file(cmake/openblas.pc.in → openblas.pc) and line 619 install(FILES … DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig/). Bazel side: gen_openblas_pc (write_file) emits openblas.pc with fixed /usr/local paths, but there is no pkg_files target placing it under any pkgconfig/ prefix.

findings.summary: Benchmark executables entirely absent — the BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON code path producing ~30 benchmark_* cc_binary targets is not represented in Bazel
findings.evidence: cmake side: lines 469–522 enumerate benchmark/*.c, compile each with DEFAULT/COMPLEX/DOUBLE/COMPLEX+DOUBLE variants into ~30 add_executable targets linked against the openblas library. Bazel side: BUILD_BENCHMARKS is baked OFF (BUILD.bazel line 8) with no corresponding cc_binary targets and no TODO entry in conversion-todos.json. The benchmark/ directory headers are listed in root_headers but no executables exist.
